windows.title: Kill after intent persist, before dispatch
windows.description: The user intent is durably persisted, then the process dies before provider dispatch.

annotation.injectionPoint: after the turn-intent journal record is appended and fsynced, before provider dispatch
annotation.expectedObservableState: exactly one persisted intent is found; no assistant output was emitted; the turn is resumable
annotation.forbiddenRerunRegion: do not re-append the persisted user intent and do not replay any tool call that already started
annotation.allowedRerunRegion: may schedule the unstarted turn from the persisted intent

windows.title: Kill after external effect, before receipt persist
windows.description: The external side effect committed, but the process died before the effect receipt was persisted.

annotation.injectionPoint: after the external effect commits, before its effect receipt is persisted
annotation.expectedObservableState: the effect exists once; the missing receipt is classified as unknown and is never silently replayed
annotation.forbiddenRerunRegion: do not replay the tool invocation whose side effect may have committed
annotation.allowedRerunRegion: may reconcile through the idempotency key, or mark the effect unreceipted and require explicit continuation
requiredDiskEvidence: effect log entry or idempotency key

windows.title: Kill after child creation, before parent advance
windows.description: A child task was durably created, but the parent node did not advance before the process died.

annotation.injectionPoint: after the child task record is durably created, before the parent task node advances
annotation.expectedObservableState: the child exists exactly once and is linked to the parent; the parent stays at its pre-advance state
annotation.forbiddenRerunRegion: do not create a second child and do not re-run child initialization
annotation.allowedRerunRegion: may re-link the existing child and advance the parent after verifying child identity

windows.title: Store write failure
windows.description: The durable store rejects or fails a write (ENOSPC / EACCES / abrupt I/O failure).

annotation.injectionPoint: during a store write, before the write acknowledgment is returned
annotation.expectedObservableState: the write is reported as failed; no silent success; the previous durable state remains readable
annotation.forbiddenRerunRegion: do not report write success and do not advance state on an unacknowledged store write
annotation.allowedRerunRegion: may retry the same idempotent write or fall back to the append-only journal when one exists
requiredDiskEvidence: last durable snapshot or journal offset

windows.title: Repeated restart at the same recovery boundary
windows.description: The process restarts repeatedly (at least three times) at the same or adjacent recovery boundary.

annotation.injectionPoint: restart at least three times while the same recovery boundary is pending
annotation.expectedObservableState: every restart converges on the same task state with no duplicate effect and no orphan child
annotation.forbiddenRerunRegion: do not replay completed effects and do not re-create children that survived a prior restart
annotation.allowedRerunRegion: may re-scan the journal, re-link surviving children, and resume only the not-yet-committed step
requiredDiskEvidence: final task, effect and child state dump
